research.research_brief: Conduct comprehensive research on the release audit process, focusing on the requirements for approval, documentation updates, and human sign-off procedures. Investigate past release incidents to understand rollback protocols and ensure compliance with the workflow's exit contract.
research.prior_art: Prior art includes software release management frameworks such as GitOps, continuous delivery pipelines, and audit trail methodologies. Research focuses on establishing a robust audit process that ensures all downstream assertions are met before any release is considered official, with particular attention to rollback procedures in case of failure.

plan: Research and document the current release audit process requirements
Identify and analyze past release incidents for rollback protocol insights
Establish approval criteria for release audit verdicts
Define documentation update procedures that must be completed before release
Create human sign-off protocols for release approval
Develop rollback procedures for failed releases
Verify compliance with workflow's exit contract requirements
acceptance_criteria: All downstream assertions are met: output.verdict == 'approve', output.docs_updated == true, output.signed_off == true, and either output.released == true or output.rolled_back == true
Release audit process documentation is complete and approved

Human sign-off workflow is established and functional
